title: Section 98.1103 Use and Sale of Algorithmic Devices Prohibited
requirement: It is unlawful for any person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord, and unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
exemptions: Software or products used to publish reports regarding rental rates or occupancy levels from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old or public information without recommending future rates/renewals, and software or products used to establish rental rates or income limits under affordable housing program guidelines.
quoted_span: It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord.
